references.observation: The bridge photograph shows a level stone beam deck on two masonry piers, three rectangular water openings, solid paneled parapets and low scrolling end pieces.
Leaf-off imagery shows the path crossing the narrow water arm near the south entrance to the wooded Water Village area.

map.deckWidthBasis: Estimated from stone railing, deck, figures and visible pier proportions in the photograph across the inlet.
map.matchedRoute: The mapped bridge crosses the narrow inlet on the south approach to the Water Village court. Its path and cover are visible in the 2022 overhead image.

limitations: The deck width, pier courses, parapet depth and relief border profiles use photo estimates.
A shallow deck grade meets the standard sampled footpath. The exact stone elevations and pond stage vary in the real site.
